title: k8s node provisioning breadcrumbs
content:
Quick breadcrumb log for recurring node NotReady during autoscaling. Meant as a scratchpad for commands to run, observations, and hypotheses. Keep notes short and actionable.

Observed behavior:
- New EC2 nodes in ASG often stay in NotReady for 5-20m then become Ready or are terminated by autoscaler.
- kubelet errors: 'Unable to register node ... dial tcp 10.0.0.1:6443: connect: connection timed out' and 'Failed to create pod infra container'.
- aws-node logs sometimes show metadata timeouts talking to 169.254.169.254.
- containerd shows overlay mount errors on pause infra containers in a few cases.

Recent commands I ran (timestamps approx):
- kubectl get nodes -o wide
- kubectl describe node $NODE
- ssh ec2-user@$NODE 'sudo journalctl -u kubelet -n 300 --no-pager'
  -> E1101 11:12:03 kubelet: Unable to register node ... dial tcp 10.0.0.1:6443: connect: connection timed out
  -> E1101 11:12:05 kubelet_pods.go: Failed to create pod infra container: failed to create containerd task
- ssh ec2-user@$NODE 'sudo journalctl -u cloud-init -n 200; sudo cat /var/log/cloud-init-output.log'
- kubectl -n kube-system logs ds/aws-node -l k8s-app=aws-node --tail=300
  -> ec2_metadata.go: failed to get instance-id from metadata: context deadline exceeded
- sudo crictl ps -a ; sudo crictl logs <pause-id>

Hypotheses to validate:
- IMDS v2 / metadata access delays during boot. If cloud-init/userdata relies on IMDS calls and they time out, CNI may fail to allocate ENIs.
- ENI/IP capacity: instance type + pod density may exceed IP limits causing ipam failures and CNI errors.
- AMI drift: kubelet/kube-proxy versions or kernel modules not matching expectations (ipvs modules missing).
- Filesystem overlay issues on new volumes causing containerd mount failures.
- Race between node registration and autoscaler uncordon/ASG checks. Need a readiness gate.

Quick repro steps to capture more data (staging):
1) Launch identical ASG with same AMI and instrument userdata to write full cloud-init-output.log and a bootstrap trace to S3.
2) Add tcpdump on metadata endpoint and capture first 5 minutes of boot.
3) Run a debug daemonset that collects journalctl (kubelet, cloud-init, containerd), /var/log/cloud-init-output.log, and crictl ps -a to S3 on node NotReady.
4) Force a kube-proxy restart to observe iptables/ipvs restore logs. Check lsmod | grep ip_vs.
5) Pin AMI on one ASG and compare version binaries: /usr/bin/kubelet --version ; /usr/bin/kube-proxy --version.

Proposed mitigations to test quickly:
- Add a small post-boot healthcheck in userdata that signals readiness (e.g., curl S3 pre-signed URL) and configure autoscaler/ASG to wait for that tag before considering node healthy.
- Ensure AMI has correct ipvs modules and kernel config if kube-proxy runs in ipvs mode.
- Lower pod density / increase instance ENI allotment until we confirm ipam stability.
- Make cloud-init retry metadata calls with IMDSv2 tokens and log failures.

Copy-paste commands when triaging next instance (ordered):
- kubectl describe node $NODE
- kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.kind=Node,metadata.name=$NODE --sort-by=.lastTimestamp
- ssh ec2-user@$NODE 'sudo journalctl -u kubelet -n 400 --no-pager'
- ssh ec2-user@$NODE 'sudo journalctl -u cloud-init -n 200 --no-pager; sudo cat /var/log/cloud-init-output.log'
- kubectl -n kube-system logs ds/aws-node -l k8s-app=aws-node --tail=400
- sudo crictl ps -a ; sudo crictl logs <pause-id>
- aws ec2 describe-instances --instance-ids $INSTANCE_ID --query 'Reservations[].Instances[].NetworkInterfaces'

Breadcrumbs / small notes:
- Manual systemctl restart kubelet sometimes kicks the node to Ready faster than terminating -> indicates transient network issue that resolves.
- Seen ipvs 'invalid argument' on kube-proxy restore after restarts on older AMI kernels.
- RUN-3214 created to track AMI rebuild and autoscaler guard (assigned to Aisha).

Open questions:
- Do security/infrastructure want IMDSv2-only? If so, ensure userdata uses token flow.
- Is there appetite to add a pre-uncordon delay in autoscaler? Tradeoffs: temporary wasted capacity vs reduced flapping.
- Can we add more robust cloud-init logging to capture first-run metadata timeouts?

Next actions (me):
- Add tcpdump + metadata logging to staging AMI build this week.
- Coordinate with Aisha on RUN-3214 to schedule AMI pin test.
- Prototype small S3-based readiness ping in userdata and test scale-up.

-- Jordan (quick scratchpad)
